translations.translatedText: # Thursday 6.7.2017 (radio)

US President Donald Trump is on a visit to Europe. Few babies are being born in Finland now. Venla Harju won a World Championship bronze medal. Thursday was the day of Eino Leino, poetry and summer. It has rained a lot in Lapland.
## Trump in Poland
![Donald Trump speaks in Warsaw.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9709855)
Open image viewer
Trump spoke to Poles in Warsaw. Photo: Saul Loeb / AFP
US President Donald Trump is on a visit to Europe.
On Thursday Trump spoke in Poland's capital, Warsaw. Trump promised that the USA is a strong partner for the countries of Eastern Europe. Trump said that Russia must stop disturbing Ukraine.
Trump also remembered Poland's suffering in the Second World War. Trump praised Poland and said that Poland is a good example for other countries too.
## Few babies
![a baby](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9676956)
Open image viewer
During the first part of the year, fewer babies than usual have been born. Photo: AOP
Few babies are being born in Finland now.
At the start of this year clearly fewer children were born than a year ago. Between January and May, 7 percent fewer children were born than at the same time last year.

If the situation stays the same in the second half of the year, fewer than 50,000 children will be born this year. That last happened almost 150 years ago, in 1868. That was a bad famine year; there was not enough food for everyone.
## A bronze medal for Harju
![Venla Harju at the World Orienteering Championships in Tartu, Estonia, on 6 July 2017. ](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9710187)
Open image viewer
Venla Harju orienteered well and won a bronze medal. Photo: Kimmo Hirvonen / Lehtikuva
Finland has won a medal at the World Orienteering Championships. Orienteers from different countries are competing in Estonia over who is world champion.
In the women's middle distance race, Finland's Venla Harju was third. She won a bronze medal. The winner of the race was a Swedish orienteer, and a Norwegian orienteer was second best.
In orienteering, competitors run, for example, in a forest and look for checkpoints, that is, places marked on the map.
## Leino Day
![The statue of Eino Leino in Helsinki.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9572464)
Open image viewer
The statue of Eino Leino in Helsinki. Photo: Esa Hiltula / AOP
Thursday was the day of Eino Leino, poetry and summer. The day is always celebrated on the 6th of July, because it is Eino Leino's birthday. Leino was born in 1878, 139 years ago.
Eino Leino was a Finnish writer. He wrote a lot of poems. Leino's Helkavirsiä (Whitsongs) is an important book of poems for Finns.
The day of Eino Leino and summer is a flag day. Flags fly in honour of summer and poems.
## Cold Lapland
![Pedestrians in the rain.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9705841)
Open image viewer
The weather has been bad this summer. Photo: Heikki Saukkomaa / Lehtikuva
The weather is not very summery now.

It has rained a lot in the north. Yle meteorologist Matti Huutonen says that during the night between Wednesday and Thursday as much as 5 centimetres of rain fell in Lapland. In Kittilä 7 centimetres of rain fell. That is as much as usually falls in the whole of July.
It is also quite cold in the north. Huutonen says that during the night between Thursday and Friday there may even be frost in Lapland.
